findings.title: Preserve the verdict when stdout is closed at startup
findings.body: Launching with `1>&-` makes Python set `sys.stdout` to `None`. The preceding prints silently skip output, but the new unconditional `flush()` raises `AttributeError`, so `entry()` returns 2 after recording a successful review or findings. The base returned the correct 0 or 1 in this scenario. The added tests close a stdout pipe but never test stdout already closed at startup.
